name: Barry Lyndon candlelit period tableau
summary: A soft, grainy 35mm period frame lit only by candle flames or diffuse window daylight, warm amber against deep brown shadows, with a razor-thin plane of focus and a still, painterly 18th-century composition.

lineage.era: mid-1970s 35mm film; Eastman 100T stock pushed one stop; Zeiss Planar 50mm f/0.7

traits.line: none - photographic, soft edges; the out-of-focus plane melts contours within a few centimetres of the focus point
traits.shading: low-contrast, gentle tonality: shadows are deep brown-black but milky and still hold detail; highlights bloom and roll off softly instead of clipping; candle flames glow with soft halos
traits.palette: warm, restrained earth palette - amber and gold candlelight, brown and umber shadows, dusty powder-blue and muted green in fabrics and skies; no saturated or neon colour; day interiors cool grey-white
traits.lighting: night interiors lit only by clusters of real candles in frame (low, warm, close to faces, falloff to dark within a metre); day interiors lit by large diffused window light from one side, like a Vermeer or Dutch interior; exteriors natural overcast English light
traits.faces: powdered white 18th-century makeup, rouged cheeks, wigs and beauty patches; faces lit from below and in front by candle glow, warm and slightly ruddy; soft, unretouched film skin
traits.backgrounds: real stately-home interiors and landscapes - tapestries, gilt frames, panelled rooms; at night the background falls into soft dark blur; by day deep, flat tableau with figures small in large rooms or parkland
traits.texture: prominent organic 35mm grain, softer than modern lenses, low-contrast filtering, slight lens softness and glow at f/0.7; no digital sharpness
traits.camera: 1.66:1 frame, locked-off and symmetrical, generous headroom like a framed painting; famous slow zoom-outs from a detail to a wide tableau that flatten depth; very little dolly movement

style_words: 35mm period film still in the manner of Barry Lyndon (1975), cinematographer John Alcott: lit only by candle flames or soft diffused window daylight, warm amber and umber palette, extremely shallow f/0.7 focus, low contrast, milky shadows, blooming highlights, visible film grain, 1.66:1 frame, still painterly 18th-century tableau composition.
avoid: turns into a crisp modern digital image with deep focus and sharp edges
off-screen orange key light instead of the candles in frame (faces brighter than the flames could make them)
high-contrast crushed blacks or a glossy HDR period-drama grade
teal-and-orange or saturated costume colours instead of the dusty earth palette
becomes a literal oil painting with brushstrokes rather than a photograph that resembles one
Victorian or Regency costume drift; wrong period hair and makeup

krea2.style: 35mm period film still in the manner of Barry Lyndon: lit only by candle flames in frame or soft diffused window daylight, warm amber, umber and dusty powder-blue palette, extremely shallow f/0.7 focus, low contrast, milky shadows that hold detail, blooming highlights, organic film grain, still symmetrical tableau composition.
krea2.recap: Shot throughout as a 35mm period film still lit by candlelight and soft window daylight, with visible film grain.

flux3_klein.style: 35mm period film photograph in the register of Barry Lyndon: a still frame lit only by flames inside the frame or by soft diffused daylight from one side, extremely shallow f/0.7 focus with contours melting a few centimetres from the focal plane, low contrast with milky brown-black shadows that hold detail, highlights that bloom and roll off, soft halos around flames, prominent organic film grain, slight lens softness, a still symmetrical tableau composition like a framed painting on a photographic surface.
flux3_klein.recap: Amber and gold stay inside the flame light and on the lit faces, brown and umber fill the shadow fills, the walls and the ground, dusty powder blue and muted green sit only in the sky and the daylight, and every garment keeps its own stated colour at low saturation.
